'''Daniela Kolbe''' (born 22 February 1980) is a German physicist and politician of the [[Social Democratic Party of Germany|Social Democratic Party]] (SPD) who served as a member of the [[Bundestag]] from the state of [[Saxony]] from 2009 until 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.abgeordnetenwatch.de/profile/daniela-kolbe|title=Daniela Kolbe {{!}} Abgeordnetenwatch|website=www.abgeordnetenwatch.de|language=de|access-date=2020-03-20}}</ref>

== Political career ==
Kolbe first became member of the Bundestag in the [[2009 German federal election]], representing the [[Leipzig I]] district.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.spdfraktion.de/abgeordnete/kolbe-leipzig|title=Daniela Kolbe (Leipzig), MdB|date=2011-06-27|website=SPD-Bundestagsfraktion|language=de|access-date=2020-03-20}}</ref> In parliament, she first served on the Committee on Internal Affairs from 2009 until 2013. From 2014 until 2021, she served on the Committee for Labour and Social Affairs.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bundestag.de/en/committees/a11|title=German Bundestag – Labour and Social Affairs|website=German Bundestag|language=en|access-date=2020-03-20}}</ref> Within her parliamentary group, she chaired the [[caucus]] of MPs from Germany's Eastern states from 2013 until 2015. Since 2014, she has been part of the SPD's leadership in Saxony under chairman [[Martin Dulig]].

In September 2019, Kolbe announced that she would not stand in the [[2021 German federal election|2021 federal elections]] but instead resign from national politics by the end of the parliamentary term.<ref>[https://www.lvz.de/Leipzig/Lokales/Will-die-SPD-Daniela-Kolbe-ins-Leipziger-Rathaus-holen Will die SPD Daniela Kolbe ins Leipziger Rathaus holen?] ''[[Leipziger Volkszeitung]]'', September 3, 2020.</ref><ref>[https://www.bild.de/regional/leipzig/leipzig-news/leipziger-spd-abgeordnete-kolbe-macht-schluss-mit-bundestag-65250324.bild.html Leipziger SPD-Abgeordnete: Kolbe macht Schluss mit Bundestag] ''[[Bild]]'', October 10, 2020.</ref>
